1: export interface WindowMetrics {
2:   width: number
3:   height: number
4:   statusBarHeight: number
5:   safeTop: number
6:   safeBottom: number
7:   safeLeft: number
8:   safeRight: number
9: }
10: 
11: // These are CSS/uni window pixels, not physical screen pixels or native dp.
12: export function gameWindowLayout(window: WindowMetrics) {
13:   const width = Math.max(0, window.width - window.safeLeft - window.safeRight)
14:   const height = Math.max(0, window.height - Math.max(window.statusBarHeight, window.safeTop) - window.safeBottom)
15:   const split = width >= 640 && height >= 320
16:   const controls = split ? Math.min(320, Math.max(240, width * .32)) : 0
17:   const available = Math.max(0, Math.min(width, 1120) - 24 - (split ? controls + 24 : 0))
18:   // A short viewport scrolls instead of forcing an unreadable 9×9 grid.
19:   // Reserve room for the stable header/context block. Extra notices or large
20:   // system text can still grow the page; keep a readable minimum and scroll.
21:   const heightLimit = Math.max(306, height - 168)
22:   const boardSize = Math.floor(Math.min(available, heightLimit, split ? 600 : 520))
23:   return { split, boardSize, controlsWidth: controls }
24: }
